description: This file defines classes and functions related to an event registry system for engine control, including classes for injection and ignition events, their constructors, data members, and some associated functions.

classes.name: InjectionEvent
classes.description: Represents an injection event with properties indicating its timing characteristics and output targets.

classes.name: event_trigger_position_s
classes.description: Defines the positional parameters for triggering events based on engine angle or position.

classes.name: IgnitionEvent
classes.description: Represents an ignition event, including its name, output signals, and ignition advance parameters.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Defines output pins for ignition signals (implied by usage).

methods.name: event_trigger_position_s()
methods.description: Constructor initializing event trigger position data.

methods.name: IgnitionOutputPin * getOutputForLoggins()
methods.description: Returns the output pin for logging purposes in an ignition event.
